=== Infusing and Enriching Atmacite ===
Players in possession of one or more [[Periapt of emergence|Periapts of emergence]] can infuse obtained [[atmacite]]s for a nominal cruor fee at any Atmacite Refiner. Once infused, the atmacite will automatically become active each time a player engages in a Voidwatch battle until the player chooses to purge the atmacite. Atmacites must be purged before a new atmacite can be infused.

Players may also pay the Atmacite Refiners to enrich [[:Category:Atmacite|Atmacite]] that they receive in battles. Each Atmacite can progress to level 15 after 14 upgrades, with a variable cost progression based on Cruor. 

Atmacite can also be infused, purged, and enriched at any [[Planar Rift]] prior to engaging in battle.

=== Upgrading Stratum Abyssite ===
Upon completing the Voidwatch battle(s) associated with a particular tier and color of stratum abyssite, the stratum abyssite must be inspected by any Atmacite Refiner NPC in order to be upgraded to the next tier. Atmacite refiners can upgrade indigo, jade, crimson, and certain tiers of white stratum abyssites. Ashen stratum abyssite and other white statum abyssite tiers are upgraded through [[Voidwatch Quests]].

== Teleportation ==
Atmacite Refiner NPCs can teleport players to Voidwatch areas in which they can start battles (determined by the levels of their Stratum Abyssites). Each teleport costs 1,000 [[Cruor]].

The following teleportation options are available upon speaking with an Atmacite Refiner. The type and tier of required Stratum Abyssite to have access to each teleportation option is noted next to the area. Areas related to "VW Ops" [[Voidwatch Quests]] cannot be teleported to until the quest has been activated. Available destinations are dependent upon whether you are interacting with a present-day or past Atmacite Refiner, but are not dependent on the location you are teleporting from (all destinations in each time period are available from any Atmacite Refiner in that time period). Teleports to field areas will bring you into the zone near one of the zone's entrances and typically in close proximity to at least one of the zone's [[Planar Rift]]s. Teleports to dungeon areas will bring you immediately outside one of the zone entrances. This is not always the front/main entrance when a dungeon has more than one entrance.
